content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing prior authorization, and Meridian’s retro-authorization window is closed; it also offers no peer-to-peer review, and a necessity appeal has already been attempted. Correcting the invalid diagnosis pairing would not cure the authorization denial, while resubmission or another unavailable review would violate or fail the published path. No contractual patient share was established on this denied claim, so the balance is not properly billable to the patient.","action":"write_off"}
